title: State space of the sweep simulator
statement: For a symbol alphabet $\Gamma$, a state type $Q$, and a nonnegative integer $k$, the state space of the sweep simulator is the disjoint union of sweep states and tuples consisting of an optional state in $Q$, a Boolean flag for each of the $k$ tapes, and a counter in $\{0,\ldots,k\}$.
caveat: The component $\operatorname{SweepState}(\Gamma,Q,k)$ is not defined in the supplied statement, so that summand cannot be described further.
